correctness.rationale: The unique 2-cycle follows from a 2-adic contraction of f^2 on even inputs. Exact parity-class valuation identities give error gains of 2 and 1 alternately; counts of roots of odd squares modulo powers of 2 give O_k and E_k. This proves all k>=3 and classifies all residue depths, without extrapolating from finite calculations. The independent brute-force script confirms k=3..14.

value.rationale: The first-entry-time distribution is a natural complete invariant of a modular functional graph; existing general basin theory leaves its finite resolution unquantified. The closed formula supplies all preperiodic vertex heights, a sharp linear-in-k maximal transient, and exact characterization of the quarter of residues attaining it. This is a structural census, not an arbitrary finite slice or numerical pattern.
